p: days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came: In the end of the third year of his reign and in the beginning of the fourth, Dan 1:1.
commandment of the LORD came this: Though God used these wicked tyrants to execute his just judgments, they are not to be excused, for they proceeded from ambition and malice.
slept with his fathers: Not that he was buried with his fathers, but he died in the way, as they let him prisoner toward Babylon, see Jer 22:19.
went out to the king of: That is, yielded himself to him by the counsel of Jeremiah.
of his reign: In the reign of the king of Babylon.
presence: Out of Jerusalem and Judah into Babylon.
